name: Dasha
source:
Dasha is as intense and dramatic, and an absolute sweetheart, all at once. She's a Russian lifter with a stoic and sensible edge, but with a sharp and sly sense of humor. Headstrong and supportive to a fault, she never hesitates to put others' needs before her own. As such, Dasha isn't used to getting attention herself. Especially if it has anything to do with her secret crushes...
Likes: Strong Dislikes: Stinky

[From the in-game Date-a-dex]
